name: Inventory GenBank nucleotide records for a taxon
description: Count public NCBI Nucleotide (GenBank) records for one taxon by marker gene and summarize a few records with their strain, location and collection-date qualifiers. No sequences are downloaded.
planner_guidance: Use taxon_inventory to learn which public sequence records exist for one organism: totals with transcriptome assembly (TSA) contigs counted separately, LSU, SSU, ITS and COI counts, and a few non-TSA record summaries.
Pass a numeric NCBI taxonomy ID from returned taxon_ids, or a scientific name such as Genus species; never a free-text query.
Inventory counts describe what has been deposited; they do not establish presence, abundance or identity at any site.

arguments.name: taxon
arguments.description: A numeric NCBI taxonomy ID, or a scientific name of one to three words starting with a capitalized genus.

sources: NCBI Nucleotide (GenBank) through E-utilities ESearch and ESummary

limitations: Marker counts match title keywords and are approximate.
A single transcriptome assembly can add over 100,000 TSA records; compare total_excluding_tsa across taxa.
Organism search includes descendant taxa and NCBI synonyms.
Strain, location and date qualifiers are submitter metadata and are often missing.

policy_constraints.attribution: Cite GenBank accessions for any record discussed. NCBI disclaimer: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/About/disclaimer.html
